Real Estate · Case study

Classic Group

One of Raipur's established developers. We repositioned the group as a premium lifestyle brand, rebuilt its creative system, and ran always-on campaigns that turned attention into site visits.

  • 500+Quality leads generated
  • FullBrand redesign
  • PremiumMarket positioning
challenge

Classic Group markets several residential projects — Classic Castle, Classic Towers, Sumeet Landscape — to an aspirational buyer. The brand looked like a dozen other local developers, and the marketing had to feel premium and stay consistent across formats as different as an Instagram carousel, a highway hoarding and a full newspaper page.

approach

We rebuilt the identity around a single premium system, then built an always-on engine: a monthly creative series, AI-assisted walkthrough reels, an ad film, and an out-of-home rollout — hoardings, pole-kiosk routes and press. Every piece pointed to a lead form and was measured against cost per enquiry.

result

A consistent, premium presence across every touchpoint and 500+ qualified leads from the campaigns — with the brand finally looking like the market leader it is.
